DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia (Jaundice)

The patient is a newborn with jaundice spreading from the face to the trunk and scleral icterus. This clinical picture is inconsistent with acute appendicitis, which is rare in newborns and presents with different symptoms. I have requested a bilirubin level and skin images to confirm the diagnosis.
